subject: Your room and door code
body:
Hi Meera,

You're all checked in. Room 412 is being prepared - it's ready at 2:00 PM. Your door code 5-6-2-8 activates at 2:00 PM.

Once it activates, use it at the door any time during your stay - no key needed.

The Hotel Aurora team

This message was prepared with AI assistance and reviewed by our team before it was sent. Reply any time to reach a person directly.
